Blinky-Lite™

A complete platform for monitoring and control.

Blinky-Lite brings device communication, monitoring, applications and access controls together in an open-source platform designed for complex equipment.

Explore the architecture Discuss your project

Core capabilities

From device information to informed response.

Remote access

Use web applications to give authorized specialists access to equipment information and controls from desktops, tablets or mobile devices.

Alarms and notifications

Monitor equipment conditions and use alarm and notification capabilities to help teams respond when attention is needed.

Data and history

View device information and plots, and use data archiving and access and setting history to understand system activity.

Custom applications

Use the application builder and its library of cards and widgets to configure dashboards for your equipment.

Controlled access

Use authentication and role-based permissions to control access to applications and data. Security also depends on deployment and ongoing operation.

Device integration

Connect devices through publish-subscribe messaging and integrate their information into Blinky-Lite applications.

Built to adapt

Make the interface fit the equipment.

Different facilities need different views of their systems. Blinky-Lite includes an application builder for configuring dashboard applications and a framework for developing additional application components.

BL Monitor and Control can help integrate the platform with your equipment and develop solutions for your requirements.

Open source and integration expertise

Blinky-Lite is released under the MIT License. Customers can use and adapt the available code and choose how they obtain integration and support.
